svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: How one question becomes one answer in Room of Models
svg.desc: Five AI models answer a question independently in round one with no connections between them, then exchange answers across three further rounds, and the whole transcript flows into a single synthesis node.
svg.text: How one question becomes one answer
Five frontier models, four rounds, one synthesis — the shape of a single run.
fresh context — it reads the record, it does not carry its own side
One answer, with the disagreements still inspectable
carries its own memory forward — the same conversation, one turn longer
receives every other model's answer — never its own
every turn joins the transcript the synthesizer reads
Colour is the model that spoke.
Every arc is one API call, made from the browser.
